participant_1.name: Tom
participant_1.personality: Enthusiastic and energetic, loves helping others achieve their fitness goals.
participant_1.background: my parents were both very athletic. i got a new job just yesterday to be a life coach. i love running and preparing for marathons. i'm a clean eater.

participant_2.name: Ted
participant_2.personality: Cheerful and nostalgic, enjoys life and embraces his age with a positive attitude.
participant_2.background: i'm 100 years old. i'm very strong for my age. i feel like i might live forever. i remember when nobody had a television. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.
